reference.title: Index GitHub PRs and issues into CodeDB
reference.summary: Designed and shipped a GitHub data indexing pipeline that pulls PR diffs, review comments, descriptions, and issues into the ledger under data/github/YYYY/MM/DD and indexes them into CodeDB for local semantic search. The work pushed through several architectural decisions: a time-partitioned storage layout, sparse-checkout windowing to keep local disks small, multi-writer conflict resolution for distributed daemon sync, and a unified top-level ox index command that replaced the narrower ox ledger sync-github. Along the way the session moved the sync cursor from XDG cache into the ledger cache so state survives across worktrees, extended the IPC protocol to support --full reindex, and wired ox doctor repairs for conflict recovery. Outcome: the full pipeline landed end to end.
key_actions: Designed data/github/YYYY/MM/DD/{pr,issue}/NNN.json time-partitioned layout in the ledger
Implemented GitHub REST extraction for PR diffs, review comments, descriptions, and issues
Built the unified ox index command (code + github subcommands) to replace ox ledger sync-github
Added sparse-checkout windowing so only recent PR/issue data lives locally
Resolved multi-writer conflicts in distributed daemon sync
Moved sync cursor state from XDG cache into the ledger cache for cross-worktree persistence
Extended the IPC protocol to support --full reindex
Added ox doctor repairs for conflict resolution
